bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to housing; establishing a regional housing navigator program; appropriating money for regional housing navigators; establishing the housing choice voucher account; transferring money to the housing choice voucher account; requiring reports; requiring the commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency to identify recommendations for improvements to affordable housing rental voucher programs; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 462A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[462A.2098] REGIONAL HOUSING NAVIGATOR PROGRAM.

Subdivision 1.

Establishment.

The commissioner of the Housing Finance Agency must establish a statewide network of at least five regional housing navigators. Each navigator must be in a different region of the state and support families who receive rental vouchers by connecting them with suitable housing.

Subd. 2.

Definition.

For the purposes of this section, "rental vouchers" includes housing assistance vouchers under Section 8 of the United States Housing Act of 1937, as amended, and rental assistance vouchers under section 462A.2095.

Subd. 3.

Duties.

Each housing navigator must assist families who receive rental vouchers in locating available rental housing, communicating with housing providers, connecting with additional resources, arranging inspections, and coordinating move-in procedures. Housing navigators must also serve as a resource for affordable rental housing providers to address issues that arise with people who receive rental vouchers.

Subd. 4.

Regional planning.

At least twice annually, each regional housing navigator must convene a meeting with local housing providers and other interested stakeholders to discuss issues, seek potential solutions, and identify opportunities for improvements in the affordable rental housing market.

Subd. 5.

Statewide planning.

At least once each year, the commissioner must convene a meeting with all regional housing navigators to discuss issues, seek potential solutions, and identify opportunities for improvements in the affordable rental housing market.

Sec. 2.

[462A.2099] HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER ACCOUNT.

Subdivision 1.

Creation.

The housing choice voucher account is created as a separate account in the housing development fund.

Subd. 2.

Rental housing.

The agency may use money from the housing choice voucher account to provide incentives to affordable rental housing providers who lease to people who receive rental vouchers, as defined in section 462A.2098, subdivision 2. Grants may be awarded to rental housing providers for:

(1) signing bonuses for leasing to new families;

(2) costs associated with initiating new leases;

(3) reimbursement for losses incurred when holding units open for people who receive rental vouchers; and

(4) reimbursement for the cost of repairs.

Subd. 3.

Report.

(a) The agency must work with regional housing navigators established under section 462A.2098, affordable rental housing providers, and other stakeholders to identify recommendations for improvements to the process and procedures for providing suitable housing to families who receive rental vouchers, as defined in section 462A.2098, subdivision 2. The agency must consider:

(1) developing policies for the portability of rental vouchers;

(2) streamlining administration and procedures across different affordable rental housing programs;

(3) providing consistency in rental housing inspections; and

(4) developing improvements to the rental assistance program in section 462A.2095.

(b) By January 10 each year, the commissioner shall report to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over housing finance and policy on the administrative and procedural improvements that were identified and implemented, as well as any potential changes to legislation that may be needed to support these improvements.

Sec. 3. APPROPRIATION; REGIONAL HOUSING NAVIGATOR PROGRAM.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the housing development fund to the commissioner of the Minnesota Housing Finance Agency for the regional housing navigator program under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.2098.

Sec. 4. TRANSFER; HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER ACCOUNT.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 and $....... in fiscal year 2027 are transferred from the general fund to the housing development fund. Of this transfer, $....... in each year is to the housing choice voucher account under Minnesota Statutes, section 462A.2099, in the housing development fund. This transfer is $....... in fiscal year 2028 and each year thereafter.
